answer: During each epoch, every agent locks bonded stake and evaluates a committed identity polynomial at assigned message slots. Semaphore proofs establish tree membership without revealing identity, while RLN nullifiers detect slot reuse. If duplicate messages are submitted, their transcripts reveal sufficient Shamir shares to reconstruct the sender’s private key; this proof triggers instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus a forge attempt fails, the tundra of aliases stays bounded, and the garden of participants remains sybil-resistant.
